title: Open Coffee distribution methods
description: Ways of spreading ground coffee evenly in an espresso basket before tamping (puck preparation), such as WDT, a blind shaker or Stockfleth's move. Ids match the distribution_method values coffee journals record (brew-methods family). Part of Roastbook Open Coffee.

$schema.description: Canonical URL of the schema version this file follows.

id.description: Stable readable id, the value journals record as distribution_method, for example wdt or blind_shaker. Never reused.

name.description: Common English name, for example Weiss Distribution Technique.

aliases.description: Other names and abbreviations in any language, for example WDT.

description.description: Short neutral explanation of how it is done, in our own words.

action.description: What moves the grounds. stir: needles stir through the bed; shake: the grounds are shaken in a closed cup before they go into the basket; tap: knocks settle the bed; sweep: a finger or straight edge drags across the top; rotate: a hand or tool turns on the basket.

reach.description: Which part of the dose it evens out. whole_bed: from the bottom of the basket to the top; surface: mainly the top layer.

equipment_types.description: Equipment types needed, from the equipment schema's type list, for example wdt. Absent when hands are enough.

brew_methods.description: Ids of brew methods from the brew-methods dataset this applies to, for example espresso.

creator.description: Person or company credited with the method or its first device, as they publish their name.

introduced_year.description: Year the method was first described or its first device sold.

url.description: Where the creator published the method (their own page or video).
